text:
Swing looks capped by the bias diode, not the inverter. The measured 1.427 V equals VDD − Vdsat(MB) − Vdsat(MP1) = 1.8 − 0.255 − 0.118. MB is at gm/Id ≈ 6.5 (W = 1 µm, L = 1 µm), so it has the largest Vdsat in the circuit.

The listed sensitivities miss this because Wb isn't among them. Widening MB to about 8 µm should bring its Vdsat near 0.1 V. Swing would then be about 1.57 V. The other specs should be unaffected: MB carries only iref and has no small-signal role.

```json
{"action": "refine", "reason": "Swing 1.427 = 1.8 - Vdsat(MB 0.255) - Vdsat(MP1 0.118): the ibias diode MB at gm/Id 6.5 limits swing. Widen MB (Wb≈8um) to cut its Vdsat to ~0.1V; swing becomes ~1.57V. Other specs unaffected since MB only carries iref.", "params": {"Wb": 8.0}, "bounds": {"Wb": [4.0, 20.0]}}
```
